title: Confirmation time in a permissioned retail CBDC: code, testbed and data
description: Code, testbed and data for the paper 'Confirmation time in a permissioned retail CBDC: a queueing model validated on a Hyperledger Fabric testbed'. The record contains the analytical queueing model and SimPy simulator of a Hyperledger Fabric pipeline (endorsement quorum, block formation, Raft ordering, commitment), matrix-analytic extensions for bursty arrivals and phase-type service, the five-institution Fabric 2.5.14 testbed with its build, benchmark and campaign scripts, the analysis scripts, and the measured results behind every table and figure. Start with reproduce_paper.ipynb, which rebuilds the paper's tables and figures from the saved results. data/raw/campaign_data.tar.gz holds the raw block-level measurements of all reportable rounds, and data/raw/EF_results.tar.gz the validator-failure and surge rounds, and data/raw/B10C_results.tar.gz the B = 10 drift check.
